# The Ready Consult

> AI-first growth agency: fractional CMO strategy, content, video production, SEO, and paid ads that convert attention into sustainable revenue.

The Ready Consult builds Next.js websites and layers on SEO, content, video production, paid ads, and AI-driven automation for growing B2B SaaS, ecommerce, and professional-services companies. Engagements run as embedded growth partnerships — outcome-driven pricing, live dashboards, weekly syncs.

## Services
- Fractional CMO / growth strategy
- Website design and development (Next.js)
- SEO and AEO/GEO (AI search optimization)
- Video production
- Paid ads management
- AI workflow automation
